name: Webwood Spider Silk
summary: Among Teldrassil’s boughs, Webwood Spider Silk draws the interest of suspicious figures. Webwood Lurkers spin it in the woods, and crafters put spider silk to many uses.

sections.title: A Dubious Reagent
sections.body: Webwood Lurkers near Dolanaar spin a fine, strong thread that is perilous to gather. Zenn Foulhoof, a satyr along the forest road, asks young adventurers for the silk, nightsaber fangs, and strigid owl feathers. He claims these rare reagents serve his forest business. Newcomers gather them without asking about his corrupt nature or true motives.

faq.q: Where can Webwood Spider Silk be found?
aliases: where to get webwood spider silk
faq.answer: Webwood Spider Silk comes from Webwood Lurkers and related spiders in Teldrassil’s wilds, especially near Dolanaar.
Zenn Foulhoof wants the silk. The satyr conceals his dealings just north of the path between Shadowglen and Dolanaar, and asks for it with owl feathers and predator fangs.

faq.q: Why does Zenn Foulhoof want Webwood Spider Silk?
faq.answer: Zenn says he needs the silk as a reagent for his forest business, but keeps the details to himself.

faq.q: Can players use Webwood Spider Silk for tailoring?
faq.answer: No. Though it is genuine spider silk, this harvested thread is a reagent for a task, not ordinary tailoring cloth.

angles.text: As a young night elf leaving Shadowglen, take care with the creatures you hunt, especially when a solitary satyr near your heartland asks you to gather them.
As a tailor, you may seek arachnid thread, but these swatches are bound up in dark bargains with a satyr rather than ordinary loom work.
